svg.title: Selective versus permissive tracking over the same assumed anatomy
svg.desc: Two schematic panels with identical assumed anatomy: a pathway from region R that forks into a branch to A and a main branch to B, and a separate neighbouring pathway from S to C. Selective tracking reconstructs R to B and S to C but misses the genuine branch R to A, a false negative. Permissive tracking also recovers R to A, but one streamline leaves the R pathway near the fork and continues along the neighbouring pathway to C, a connection R to C that the assumed anatomy does not contain, a false positive. Streamline density is illustrative and is not an axon count.
svg.text: recovers it, adds a false connection (false positive)
streamline consistent with the assumed anatomy
